item.title: Japan’s PayPay Files for US IPO, Targets Valuation Above US$10B
item.description: SoftBank‘s digital payments unit, PayPay, has filed publicly for a US IPO. The listing could be the largest by a Japanese company on a US exchange. PayPay may list as early as March. PayPay is seeking a valuation above US$10 billion.
